newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias up 10.53 pct on takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: Victorias up 10.53 pct on takeover talks.

text.p: Philippine sugar miller Victorias Milling Co rose by 40 centavos, or 10.53 percent, to 4.20 pesos in late trade on Wednesday on buying triggered by rumours of a possible takeover, traders said.

"It's adjusting back to the level where it should be. We see this as a technical correction and there is also speculation that there may a takeover," said Saturnino Mejia, research head at Guoco Securities (Phils) Inc.
Victorias had been able to secure a moratorium for its 4.4 billion peso principal debt payment from 32 banks.
Mejia said one of the banks with a large exposure to Victorias was rumoured to be interested in taking over the sugar miller.
Victorias officials were not immediately available for comment.
